description: This file provides functions for quoting and dequoting strings, particularly for shell safety and path handling. It includes implementations for quoting strings with single quotes, c-style quoting, shell argument quoting, and unquoting, as well as specialized quoting for different languages like Perl, Python, Tcl, and regex patterns.

methods.name: void sq_quote_buf(struct strbuf * dst,const char * src)
methods.description: Quotes a string buffer with single quotes, escaping internal single quotes and exclamation points for shell safety.

methods.name: void sq_quote_buf_pretty(struct strbuf * dst,const char * src)
methods.description: Attempts to quote a string buffer prettily; if the string contains only alphanumeric characters and specific punctuations, it is not quoted, otherwise it calls sq_quote_buf.

methods.name: void sq_quotef(struct strbuf * dst,const char * fmt,...)
methods.description: Formats a string with variadic arguments and quotes it with sq_quote_buf.

methods.name: void sq_quote_argv(struct strbuf * dst,const char ** argv)
methods.description: Quotes an array of argument strings for shell safety and combines them into a single string buffer.

methods.name: void sq_quote_argv_pretty(struct strbuf * dst,const char ** argv)
methods.description: Quotes an argument vector with optional leading space and pretty quoting where needed.

methods.name: void sq_append_quote_argv_pretty(struct strbuf * dst,const char ** argv)
methods.description: Appends a quoted argument vector with spacing and quoting as necessary.

methods.name: char * sq_dequote_step(char * arg,char ** next)
methods.description: Dequotes a string that was quoted with sq_quote_buf, handles escape characters, and returns the original string if successful.

methods.name: char * sq_dequote(char * arg)
methods.description: Dequotes a string that was quoted, returns the original string.

methods.name: int sq_dequote_to_argv(char * arg,const char *** argv,int * nr,int * alloc)
methods.description: Dequotes a string into an argument vector.

methods.name: int sq_dequote_to_strvec(char * arg,struct strvec * array)
methods.description: Dequotes a string into a strvec array.

methods.name: size_t quote_c_style(const char * name,struct strbuf * sb,FILE * fp,unsigned flags)
methods.description: Counts or writes a C-style quoted version of a string, with optional double quotes, escaping special characters.

methods.name: size_t quote_c_style_counted(const char * name,ssize_t maxlen,struct strbuf * sb,FILE * fp,unsigned flags)
methods.description: Counts or writes a quoted string in C style, escaping special characters and optionally enclosing in double quotes.

methods.name: void quote_two_c_style(struct strbuf * sb,const char * prefix,const char * path,unsigned flags)
methods.description: Quotes two paths with C-style quoting, enclosing if needed.

methods.name: void write_name_quoted(const char * name,FILE * fp,int terminator)
methods.description: Writes a quoted name to a file, with optional terminator.

methods.name: void write_name_quoted_relative(const char * name,const char * prefix,FILE * fp,int terminator)
methods.description: Writes a path relative to a prefix, quoted appropriately.

methods.name: char * quote_path(const char * in,const char * prefix,struct strbuf * out,unsigned flags)
methods.description: Returns a path relative to a prefix, properly quoted in C style, possibly enclosed in quotes if needed.

methods.name: int unquote_c_style(struct strbuf * sb,const char * quoted,const char ** endp)
methods.description: Unquotes a C-style quoted string, handling escape sequences, and updates the pointer to point at the end of the unquoted string.

methods.name: void perl_quote_buf(struct strbuf * sb,const char * src)
methods.description: Quotes a string for Perl string literals with single quotes, escaping internal quotes and backslashes.

methods.name: void perl_quote_buf_with_len(struct strbuf * sb,const char * src,size_t len)
methods.description: Quotes a string of specified length for Perl literals.

methods.name: void python_quote_buf(struct strbuf * sb,const char * src)
methods.description: Quotes a string for Python string literals, escaping newlines and quotes.

methods.name: void tcl_quote_buf(struct strbuf * sb,const char * src)
methods.description: Quotes a string for Tcl, escaping special characters and wrapping in double quotes.

methods.name: void basic_regex_quote_buf(struct strbuf * sb,const char * src)
methods.description: Quotes a string for use in regex patterns with minimal escaping.

methods.name: int cq_must_quote(char c)
methods.description: unavailable

methods.name: int need_bs_quote(char c)
methods.description: unavailable

methods.name: size_t next_quote_pos(const char * s,ssize_t maxlen)
methods.description: unavailable

methods.name: int sq_dequote_to_argv_internal(char * arg,const char *** argv,int * nr,int * alloc,struct strvec * array)
methods.description: unavailable
